selection.criterion: exact names in candidate_families (artifact_groupings joined to artifacts)
selection.invalid_inputs: retain per-artifact skip reasons; exclude from comparison
selection.population: all prepared grouping rows matching each selected name; not manually picked pairs
selection.upstream_filter: sql/create_analysis_tables.sql: frontmatter_valid=1, body_chars>50, content/name/description non-NULL, skill name occurs at least twice; each normalized description remains a group
selection.sibling_fingerprint: sql/update_artifact_groupings.sql: file entries with available hashes; unknown when composition is incomplete
selection.sibling_scan_scope: artifact_siblings.entry_type=file only; directory entries are not executable content
selection.comparison_scope: direction-supported family edges; ambiguous relationships reviewed separately

active_rules.description: Downloaded content is piped to a shell interpreter
